note: Least-privilege table grants for the API's runtime role. Every table is listed explicitly. There is no blanket grant, no default privilege and no grant on a table that the application does not use. The grant set is derived from the checked-in migrations and verified against the statements the Go writer actually executes.

rationale.games: The account game's metadata row is created, updated and read. It is never deleted: an owner deletion writes a tombstone.
rationale.archive_chunks: Archive chunks are appended and removed with their archive. They are never updated.
rationale.archive_events: Archive events are appended and removed with their archive. They are never updated.
rationale.operations: Operation receipts are appended and read. The idempotent retry path resolves a receipt, so it is updated with the accepted outcome.
rationale.deletion_tombstones: Deletion markers are append-only. The marker is the evidence that a deleted game may never be recreated.
rationale.online_matches: The match row is created, updated for every accepted state change and read.
rationale.online_seats: Seats are created with the match and updated when control changes. A seat owner is immutable, so the row is never deleted.
rationale.online_clocks: Clock rows are created with the match and updated with every accepted move and deadline reconciliation.
rationale.online_moves: Accepted moves are append-only. Rewriting a move would break final-result immutability.
rationale.online_events: The event ledger is append-only. A later reply, claim or reconnect must never rewrite an accepted event.
rationale.online_operation_receipts: Receipts are append-only so a repeated operation returns the original result.
rationale.online_queue_entries: Queue entries are created, updated when they are readied, allocated or cancelled and read by the matcher.
rationale.online_runner_leases: Runner leases are created, updated on renewal or revocation and read by the lease check.
rationale.online_public_projections: The public projection is created, updated as the game completes and removed by an explicit erasure request.
rationale.online_deletion_markers: The removal ledger is append-only. It is replayed after a restore and must survive it.
rationale.online_session_revocations: Revocations are append-only so a revoked session cannot be un-revoked.
rationale.online_guest_seat_credentials: A guest credential is created, updated when it is superseded or revoked and read for every guest request.
rationale.online_guest_ownership_proofs: An ownership proof is created, updated when it is consumed or revoked and read for an explicit account link.
rationale.online_discarded_moves: Discarded continuations are append-only; the original result stays final.
rationale.online_offers: Draw and takeback offers are created, updated when they are resolved and read for staleness.
rationale.online_public_profiles: A public profile is created, updated by its owner and read by the public profile API.
rationale.online_profile_guest_links: A guest link is created once and revoked. It is never updated.
rationale.online_turn_budgets: Per-turn budgets are append-only records of spent attempts and corrections.
